description.fun: Shuckle stores Berries inside the holes of its shell, where its digestive juices slowly ferment them into a juice it later drinks, and it can even pull in its legs and shake itself to blend the mix just right. The same juices dissolve rock so it can hide underneath. Back in Gold and Silver, a Shuckle holding a Berry could turn it into Berry Juice after a battle.
description.guide: A Bug- and Rock-type Pokémon with a soft yellow body inside a hard red shell full of holes. It stores Berries in its shell, where they ferment into a juice it drinks, and it is known for being exceptionally tough. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A shell-dwelling bug that ferments Berries into juice
